scope: Static ownership and actual adapter normalization; browser discoverability is a separate pending gate.

gridlyGeographicAuthority.rule: use containing Texas county for package ownership and county-scoped consumer loading

reviewRule.reassignmentRule: never use distance alone; require polygon containment
reviewRule.failClosed: outside-Texas or genuinely conflicting cases remain unassigned

sourceCountyDefects: county-scoped package may omit a marker physically inside the selected county
wrong county may load a geographically remote crossing
county filters, reports, alerts, and Route Watch can disagree with marker location
consumerImpact.geographicAuthorityBenefit: Package ownership and county-scoped discovery agree with the coordinate used to render and calculate proximity; All remains identity-complete subject to explicit blocked-border handling.

authorityPolicy.compatibility: Compatible by additive reconciliation index; current LP115 filter is not compatible until repaired.

geometryEvidence.assignmentEvidence: 2025 TIGER polygon containment; distance is classification only

identities.reason: Original certifier treated preserved FRA/source-county membership as package ownership. Certified geographic ownership assigns the crossing to its containing county; package and normalized stable ID agree.
